raw.summary: PTC Inc. operates as software company in the Americas, Europe, and the Asia Pacific. The company provides Windchill, a suite that manages all aspects of the product development lifecycle(PLM) that provides real-time information sharing, dynamic data visualization, collaborate across geographically distributed teams, and enabling manufacturers to elevate product development, manufacturing, field service, and end-of-life processes; ThingWorx, an Industrial Internet of Things software; ServiceMax, a service lifecycle management solutions enable co...

business.argument: 工业软件PLM/ALM/CAD/SLM矩阵(Windchill/Codebeamer/Creo/ServiceMax)+SaaS转型(Onshape/Arena);护城河=产品数据系统级记录(system of record)的极高切换成本+制造业长周期粘性;最浅处=客户IT预算周期+SaaS转型期ARR与利润的口径打架;FY25营收+19.2%/GM83.8%,仍处增发期

culture.argument: 职业经理人时代(CEO Neil Barua 2024接任,ServiceMax系),非创始人;行为级证据:SaaS转型纪律+并购聚焦工业生命周期(不跨界);投行一致Buy 20家目标(+24%);扣分=后创始人时代资本配置记录尚短,给中性分

dcf.argument: 七仓中唯一reverse-DCF隐含正增长:+6.0%/yr(其余全为负)=市场对其定价最贵;但PE12.4(TTM口径,FY25利润+95%含一次性收益需警惕高基数)对应工业软件同类仍便宜;基准(60%):ARR高个位数-低双位数增长,估值维持;悲观(30%):SaaS转型颠簸+制造业 capex 下行;乐观(10%):数字主线+AI工业应用加速;它是组合里'质量最实但安全边际最薄'的一仓

assessment.verdict: 真护城河+真转型,代价是七仓里最贵隐含预期(+6.0%),持有不追加,赚兑现的钱不赚修复的钱
